chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'Marantz turntable semi automatic belt drive' (check model, e.g. TT-series/6xxx); 'vintage Marantz stereo system rack cassette tuner amp'; 'Marantz champagne amplifier 1980s'; 'vintage stereo system job lot speakers turntable' (sold, Australia, last 12 months). Terapeak on the same. Once the turntable model and speaker brand are known, search those sold. Also Facebook Marketplace/Gumtree for vintage hi-fi systems as ASKING guide.
viewing_check: Read the model number on the turntable plinth/rear and the amp, tuner and deck fascias and rear labels (brand and model, are they all Marantz?). Read the speaker badge and rear label (brand, model, impedance). Check turntable stylus/cartridge, belt and arm condition, speaker cone surrounds and grille cloth, cassette deck door and belts, and whether any unit powers on.
